lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular staggered grid of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal region. Spots are arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a checkerboard-like arrangement of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal-facing surfaces and shadowed gradients on the ventral-facing surfaces.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A moderate density of high-luminance circular blobs is visible on the leading edge and central surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (Echeneidae family) positioned near the ventral surface and posterior to the pectoral fin.
